_comment: Single source of truth for every tunable value. Never hardcode a threshold inside a module file - import it from here.

face_verification._note: cosine similarity above this = match. Tune against data/fixtures/faces/ pairs on Day 5.

tampering_detection._dl_note: dl_probability >= high => tampered outright. <= low => clean outright. In between => borderline, consult ELA/EXIF/copy-move per tampering_detection.py fusion logic.
tampering_detection._copy_move_note: Tune min_inliers_to_flag against data/fixtures/clean/ (should stay False, even with repeated patterns like security textures) and data/fixtures/tampered/ (should flip True on genuine stamp/region duplication).
